source_text: Klagel. Jerera. 3, 58. 63. Ἐδίκασεν ὁ θεὸς ἀποκτείνας τὸν ψευδοπροφήτην καὶ τὸν βασι- λέα παραδούς, καὶ ἐπὶ τοῦ Χριστοῦ παραδοὺς τὸ ἔθνος εἰς ἅλωσιν. τὸ δὲ ἐγὼ ἐπ' ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν, ὅτι βαρὺς ἤμην αὐτοῖς καὶ φαινόμενος.
pass_a_gloss: [Pass A] God judged, having killed the false prophet and having handed over the king, and upon Christ having handed over the nation unto capture. And the “I before their eyes,” that I was heavy to them even appearing.
pass_b_english: God judged, having killed the false prophet and having handed over the king, and upon Christ having handed over the nation unto capture. And the “I before their eyes,” that I was heavy to them even appearing.

choices.why: Pauline echo at Lam 3:48 in Origen’s reading.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Origen’s Greek Lamentations fragments. Sense checked against Klostermann GCS III. Modern English not copied. OET = no previous English translation.
